message: Pre-existing, non-blocking hardening gap: if an update install handoff fails after Buddy has stopped the embedded backend but before application shutdown begins, the current app can remain open without restarting that backend. Normal macOS installer-launch failures occur before backend shutdown, most later installer failures are handled on the next launch, and the narrow Windows inconsistency is exceptional; this should not block the current updater PR. A future bounded fix may restart the previously running backend only when the install attempt fails while the application is not quitting.
